svg.aria-label: Thinking press: an n8n agent console (left) feeds one task from its hopper down the cable into the Neon thinking press — the lit die presses thinking effort onto the task on the bed. Four dials on the front row set the effort: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH (the default, lit needle) and XHIGH. The token meter tower at the back holds a 1M-token context window with ticks at 0, 256K and 512K and a lit band marking the 65,536-token max output per hop; the cost gauge reads $3 per 1M input tokens and $15 per 1M output. The approval lever throws the approved route to the lit ACT cell while unapproved work waits in the dimmed HOLD cell. Verified numbers (Nov 23, 2026): gemini-4-neon launched Nov 18, 2026; $3/1M input, $15/1M output, $0.15 cached input; 1M-token context (1,048,576); 32% lower cost per task than Carbon at high and ~3x faster; #3 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (61 at xhigh); #1 on AutomationBench (56.3%).
svg.text: 65,536 max out · #3 Index 61 · #1 Bench 56.3% · −32% / ~3× vs Carbon
